findings.title: plan.md schema missing closed status value used by all production audit files
findings.detail: plan.md line 91 defines the status enum as 'open|fixing|verifying|fixed|regression' but all 27 production findings in .audits/index.json use both 'fixed' (13 records) and 'closed' (14 records) as distinct status values. The value 'closed' is absent from the canonical schema, creating ambiguity about valid status values for any new component that reads the schema.
findings.fix_sketch: Added 'closed' to the status enum in plan.md line 91: 'open|fixing|verifying|fixed|closed|regression'.

findings.title: flock used in two specs but macOS incompatible — lane-scheduler uses mkdir locking
findings.detail: Verified not an issue: docs/self-heal-pipeline.md line 292 and docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md line 194 both explicitly recommend mkdir-based locking and note that flock(1) is unavailable on macOS. The specs are already consistent and correct. Closing as false positive.
findings.fix_sketch: False positive — both specs already use mkdir-based locking.

findings.title: audit.finding.regressed payload uses camelCase vs snake_case mismatch with index.json
findings.detail: Verified already documented: docs/ifleet-integration-adrs.md line 135 explicitly documents that trace events use camelCase (TypeScript context) while .audits/*.json files use snake_case (JSON file context), and names the fields as intentional equivalents. This is a known and documented convention difference, not a bug. Closing as false positive.
findings.fix_sketch: False positive — ADR-003 explicitly documents the camelCase/snake_case distinction as intentional.
